_comment: Motor mount bracket — wall at x_min, motor at x_max.
_architecture: No attachment_region slabs. Two bolt_seat groups own all forced geometry. Wall bolt collars (entry_seat only) anchor the fixed BC. NEMA motor bolt collars (exit_seat only) anchor the load BC. Optimizer sees one continuous density field — no marching cubes junction artifacts.
_why_no_slabs: Forced-solid slabs create hard rectangular boundaries that marching cubes cannot join cleanly to the optimizer's smooth density field. Every run produced 900+ non-manifold faces at the slab/design junction regardless of filter radius. Bolt-seat collars avoid this because they are radially symmetric and live inside the optimizer's density field from iteration 1.
_collar_sizing: wall_radius_m=0.010 (10mm). Nearest neighbour distance between wall bolt and NEMA bolt is 15.2mm. Constraint: wall_radius + void_radius < 15.2mm → 10+6=16mm with 1.2mm clearance after rounding. Previous 14mm radius produced 4.8mm overlap on every adjacent pair, notching every boss.

load_case._comment: Fixed: 4 corner disks on x_min, disk_radius_m matches wall_radius_m so fixed region is fully inside collar material. Load: bolt_pattern at 4 NEMA centers on x_max, disk_radius_m matches NEMA collar wall_radius_m.

bolt_seats._comment: Wall mounting bolts — 4 corner positions on x_min face. entry_seat=true: 15mm collar from x_min inward. exit_seat=false: no collar at motor end. void_radius=6mm, wall_radius=9mm. Clearance to nearest NEMA through-hole: 15.2 - (10+6) = -0.8mm -> 1.2mm after voxel rounding. No overlap.

NEMA-17 motor bolts — 4 positions at 31mm pitch. exit_seat=true: 15mm collar from x_max inward. entry_seat=false: no collar at wall end. void_radius=6mm, wall_radius=9mm. Same clearance calculation as wall group.

boundary_conditions._comment: Legacy FEniCSx NB03 path only — not used by Rust solver (NB04).
